title.en: How do you match a building to a catalogue height?
title.zh: 建筑高度怎样对照目录里的输送高度？

description.en: Match measured vertical and horizontal metres to the printed cell. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not convert a storey count into metres on this page.
description.zh: 用量到的垂直和水平米数对照已印格子。河北品锦机械不在本页把层数换算成米。

h1.en: How do you match a building to a catalogue height?
h1.zh: 建筑高度怎样对照目录里的输送高度？

directAnswer.en: Measure the pipe, then open the model whose vertical cell covers that measurement. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the heights on the product pages: Electric 20 is 40 m vertical, Electric 60 fine stone is 600 m vertical, Electric 80 is 300 m vertical, HBT8018 delivery height is 450 m. A storey count is not one of those cells. The construction page asks you to compare vertical conveying height with the building before you name a pump.
directAnswer.zh: 先量管路，再打开垂直格盖得住这个数的型号。邢台河北品锦机械把高度印在产品页上：电动20垂直 40 m，电动60细石垂直 600 m，电动80垂直 300 m，HBT8018 输送高度 450 m。层数不是这些格子。建筑页要求选型前用垂直输送高度对照建筑。

heading.en: What the construction page actually asks

body.en: It asks for three comparisons: vertical height, delivery capacity against the pour, and maximum aggregate against the mix. It does not publish a metres-per-floor rule. Electric 15’s own application note on this site already discusses two-to-three-floor houses beside 15–20 m vertical. That note is not a licence to invent a new floor band for Electric 40 or Electric 60.
body.zh: 它要求三项对照：垂直高度、输送量对浇筑、最大骨料对配合比。它没有公布每层多少米。本站电动15的应用说明已经把两三层房屋和垂直 15–20 m 放在一起讨论。那篇说明不能用来给电动40或电动60新编一层数区间。

body.en: Every building table prints a horizontal cell next to the vertical one. Electric 20 is 120 m / 40 m. Electric 40 fine stone is 120 m / 360 m, while its aggregate-13 row is only 40 m / 120 m. A tall vertical cell can still be the wrong row when the ground pipe is long or the stone label changes. Send both lengths.
body.zh: 每张建筑表都在垂直旁边印了水平。电动20是 120 m / 40 m。电动40细石是 120 m / 360 m，它的 13 骨料行只有 40 m / 120 m。地面管很长或石子标注变了，垂直格再高也可能是错行。两个长度都要发。

heading.en: What should Xingtai receive with the inquiry?
heading.zh: 向邢台询盘要带上什么？

body.en: Send metres and the stone label. Leave the storey count out, or treat it as a remark, not as a specification. Send Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai the mix, the largest stone or particle, the output you need, the horizontal and vertical pipe you measured, and whether the site has grid voltage or must use diesel. Use /contact, the on-site WhatsApp button, PinjinHebei@Outlook.com or 19912003025. Do not attach a project name, a country job or a daily volume the catalogue does not print.
body.zh: 请发米数和石子标注。层数可以不写，或者只当备注，不要当成规格。 请把配合比、最大石子或粒径、需要的输送量、量到的水平与垂直管路，以及现场是电网还是必须用柴油，发给邢台的河北品锦机械。途径是 /contact、站内 WhatsApp、PinjinHebei@Outlook.com 或 19912003025。不要附上目录里没有的项目名称、国家工程或日浇筑方量。

question.en: Which page has the longest printed vertical cell?
question.zh: 哪一页的垂直格印得最高？

answer.en: The site FAQ states the highest listed vertical conveying height is Electric 60 fine stone at 600 m. Diesel 120 lists 500 m. Read the stone row before using either number.
answer.zh: 网站问答写明，列出的最高垂直输送高度是电动60细石的 600 m。柴油120列出 500 m。用这两个数之前先读石子行。

question.en: Does Electric 80’s 300 m replace Electric 60’s 600 m?
question.zh: 电动80的 300 m 能代替电动60的 600 m 吗？

answer.en: No. They are different tables. Electric 80 is 900 m horizontal / 300 m vertical at 60 m³/h and ≤ 2 cm aggregate.
answer.zh: 不能。它们是不同的表。电动80是水平 900 m / 垂直 300 m、60 m³/h、骨料 ≤ 2 cm。

question.en: Will Xingtai calculate floors for me?
question.zh: 邢台会替我把楼层算成米吗？

answer.en: Send the measured pipe. The factory matches listed models. It does not add an unpublished conversion.
answer.zh: 请发量到的管路。工厂对照已列型号，不另加未公布的换算。
